continuity_retrofit.method: Explicit fixed-atom straight chords subdivided to max0.02A, then every interval probed at quarters; subdivision does not repair energy overshoot

reflection_closure.definition: Full-path reflected partners with current energy/force invariance checks, newly refined index-zero minima and index-one saddles; proper-only basin matching.
reflection_closure.caution: Symmetry-derived connections are not independent searches. Finite source path checks are inherited under the fixed orthogonal reflection.

coverage.scope: Finite searched network plus checked reflected partners. Coarse-form coverage is not proof that every physical minimum or transition has been found.
